page_title: WOL 2-2 STU | Wolfsburg v Stuttgart 28/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+8' The attendance for today's match is 27135.
90+7' 2 - 2 What a hit! Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot inside the right post. 2:2.
90+5' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) finds space near the penalty spot to plant a header at goal from the corner, but it's badly directed and drifts well wide of the right post.
90+5' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) will take a corner kick.

90+5' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play. Stuttgart are awarded a corner kick.
90+4' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) is given a yellow card.
90+3' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
90+2' This is a yellow card! Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+2' El Bilal Toure (VfB Stuttgart) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Sven Jablonski signals.
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
89' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
88' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
86' Here is a change. Maximilian Arnold is going off and Ralph Hasenhuttl gives the last tactical orders to Salih Ozcan (Wolfsburg).
86' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Kevin Behrens.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) comes onto the pitch so that Josha Vagnoman can be given a rest.
86' Sebastian Hoeness decides to make a substitution. Jamie Leweling will be replaced by Nick Woltemade (VfB Stuttgart).
85' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
83' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
81' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) latches onto a long ball into the box and unleashes a fine volley at goal, but flashes the effort just over the bar. That would have been a great goal!
80' Substitution. Mattias Svanberg makes his way off the pitch and Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) comes on as his replacement.
79' Big moment in the game as the red card awarded to Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is reduced to a yellow following the VAR review!

76' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg), but referee Sven Jablonski must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
75' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is shown a red card, but it seems like a harsh decision.
73' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) sends a long through ball to Jakub Kaminski, but he fails to control it properly and loses it to one of the defending players.
72' El Bilal Toure (VfB Stuttgart) commits a foul during an attacking move.
71' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Fabian Rieder walks off the pitch to be replaced by Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart).
71' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to make a change. El Bilal Toure (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Ermedin Demirovic.
71' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Sven Jablonski stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
68' 2 - 1 It's 2:1! Jonas Wind feeds Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the right side of the net.
65' Substitution. Tiago Tomas is replaced by Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg).
64' The free kick into the penalty area from Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is cleared.
63' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
63' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) is sent off after receiving a second yellow card from the referee!
62' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle after Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
57' Enzo Millot comes off the pitch to be replaced by Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart).

56' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) clutches his head after wasting a good opportunity. He expertly collected the ball from a rebound and fired from long range, but his effort wasn't accurate at all and the ball went miles over the crossbar.
56' A poorly taken free kick by Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart)! He sends a shot from the edge of the box into the defensive wall.
56' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
55' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
55' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) tackles a bit over-zealously and Sven Jablonski blows for a foul. Stuttgart have a free kick from a promising distance.
55' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
53' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
52' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
51' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) brings his opponent down. Sven Jablonski has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Stuttgart.
50' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) sends a long cross over to Enzo Millot, but Kamil Grabara comes forward to gather the ball.
49' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.

48' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
47' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) offside.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+1' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) gets booked for the first time in this match.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Sven Jablonski blows for a foul after Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
41' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
39' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) is free in the box and Ermedin Demirovic finds him with a pass, but his powerful shot skims just past the right post. Good chance!
38' One of the players from Wolfsburg times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
37' The game is interrupted now, Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
36' Some neat passing and movement from Stuttgart as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
32' 1 - 1 Goal! The rebound fell to Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) and he fired home from close range. The score is 1:1.
32' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot into the bottom left corner, but Kamil Grabara pulls off a superb save.
32' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
30' Poor challenge! Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) is penalised for tripping and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle. The referee blows the whistle and gives a penalty to Stuttgart!!
30' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) attempts to find Mohamed Amoura with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
28' Good chance! Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
27' The ball is cleared after Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
27' Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
26' 1:2 – the total goal attempt statistics. 1:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
24' The game is interrupted. Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
22' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) produces a cunning chipped pass for Jamie Leweling, who takes it down well but fails to get past the defenders and loses the ball.
20' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Mohamed Amoura plays the ball to the feet of Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg), who hits a tremendous first-time shot inside the right post. The goalkeeper was unable to keep it out. 1:0.
19' Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
16' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul after Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) hacks down one of his opponents. Stuttgart have been awarded a free kick.
13' Great teamplay by Stuttgart as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
11' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
10' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
8' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Alexander Nubel.

8' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for an infringement. Wolfsburg win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
6' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Kamil Grabara, who smothers the ball.
5' Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

4' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the right post, but Kamil Grabara shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Stuttgart.
3' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Sven Jablonski blows for a foul.
1' The first half has started.
Stuttgart will kick the game off.
Sven Jablonski was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
